name: Anime.js Animation Engine

rendering_constraints.notes: Anime.js lacks first-class integration with HyperFrames window.__timelines registration and would conflict with the established GSAP pipeline.

justification: BLOCKED: Redundant dependency. The repository standardized on GSAP 3 which provides proven, deterministic timeline management for HyperFrames headless capture. Introducing Anime.js creates cognitive overhead, dual timeline conflicts, and violates the repository's dependency minimization policy.
